events.title: Demo Ver.1.5: Chapter 2 "LivingArea" added & 3x more puzzles
events.summary: Thank you for playing Re:Connect! We've updated the demo to Ver.1.5 for Steam Next Fest October 2026. Based on your feedback on the May demo — "the puzzles are too easy" and "there isn't enough content" — this update adds Chapter 2, along with quality-of-life improvements and bug fixes. New features Chapter 2 "LivingArea" is now playable After the Chapter 1 ending, choose "Continue to Chapter 2" to carry on with your save data. events.summary: We've updated the Re:Connect demo! Thank you for playing. This update mainly fixes issues that could block your progress, along with a few adjustments. Progression Fixes Fixed an issue where the goal would not appear after defeating the Maid Boss if you were standing on the tile where it spawns, leaving the player unable to move. events.title: Devlog #2: Our Tokyo Game Show 2026 report
events.summary: Hi, I'm Mapyon, the developer of Re:Connect. We've wrapped up five days at SELECTED INDIE 80, Tokyo Game Show 2026. Thank you so much to everyone who stopped by our booth! Five days at our own boothLast year we showed Re:Connect in a corner of the iGi incubator booth. This year we had a booth of our own, in a busy spot that nobody could miss, with four demo stations, the most we could fit. We handed out 2,000 uchiwa fans and nearly 300 exclusive postcards. events.title: “Re:Connect” Has Been Selected for TGS 2026's “SELECTED INDIE 80”
events.summary: Hi, I'm Mapyon, the developer of Re:Connect at Studio Wink. Starting this week, I'll be posting a devlog here every week. First, some news: Re:Connect has been selected for SELECTED INDIE 80 at Tokyo Game Show 2026. You can play it at Makuhari Messe, Japan, from September 17 to 21! What is Re:Connect?If emotions can be programmed, can we call that a heart? Re:Connect is a programming puzzle adventure where you connect cords to change the rules.
